include_directories(BEFORE
    ${REACTOS_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/netapi32)
generate_idl_iids(mstask_local.idl)
spec2def(mstask.dll mstask.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No CONST_VTABLE

# mstask.dll is all Rust (mstask-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mstask-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# factory.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mstask-rust/src/mstask/factory.rs)
# mstask_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mstask-rust/src/mstask/mstask_main.rs)
# task.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mstask-rust/src/mstask/task.rs)
# task_scheduler.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mstask-rust/src/mstask/task_scheduler.rs)
# task_trigger.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mstask-rust/src/mstask/task_trigger.rs)
# stubs.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mstask-rust/src/mstask/stubs.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(mstask_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mstask_local_i.c)
target_link_libraries(mstask_shims PRIVATE uuid wine libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(mstask_shims)
add_dependencies(mstask_shims netapi32)
add_cargo_module(mstask mstask-cargo mstask.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE mstask-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mstask_shims psdk uuid_sources)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
